window.name: validation year (eval_start to F); the test year is sealed

hour_index: index i of every 24-value series is the America/Denver clock hour i

reference.note: US average CO2 intensity of generation, 2024 (785 lb/MWh); the colour scale's midpoint, a national reference, not a consumption-basis value

ci.source: EIA consumption-basis CO2 intensity (BA workbooks), tier 1 only: hours EIA publishes; no fills. An EIA estimate, hence modeled

pace_july_weekday.definition: mean over July 2025 weekdays (America/Denver; holidays included) of EIA-930 adjusted demand (isolated spikes removed), solar and wind; net load = demand − wind − solar

pace_top100_net_load.definition: the 100 highest PACE net-load hours of the window, counted by America/Denver month and hour

context_year_mean_ci.definition: unweighted hourly mean of our EIA-930 fuel-mix intensity (production basis, adjusted generation x EIA direct factors); map context only
